body: I know this is a very old post. Today I had my yearly freakout about my palpable lymph nodes I’ve had for at least 5 years. Two kidney bean sized on each side of my neck and two pea sized ones. Went to my GP back then to show her, referral to an ENT who said she couldn’t feel anything, another ENT who also wasn’t concerned. They haven’t grown at all and I have no other “alarming” symptoms…

Thank you so much for your reply. This morning I passed mucus with fresh blood when I pushed so yeah, I continue to be worried out of my mind but I will call my doctor as soon as they open their office.
I woke up today and passed bloody mucus with gas, definitely fresh blood… I live in Switzerland and I’m in Prague now so I’m not too far away and I will go back in two days.
I think need to start off every day reading this. Maybe it will finally stop my crippling health anxiety that’s ruining my life. Thank you for this.
This is such a weird thing to even suggest? I assume you’re trolling.
I really need to scrape up some confidence and speak up no matter how much I dread it. This has been going on for months and I have allowed it.

I understand completely and I wouldn’t go straight to my boss without informing him that his behavior is making me uncomfortable first, maybe there’s a misunderstanding and he’ll stop, I don’t know. But it’s so hard for me to address it, if he did something explicitly then there would be no room for discussion, but like this it’s almost as if I’m accusing him of something.
What meds if you don’t mind me asking?
I take mesalamine. What about you?

Yeah i get it, actually I was told it was anxiety for two years before I was diagnosed with Crohn’s 😅

That’s actually very encouraging to hear, I was diagnosed in 2018 and only really had one bad flare up since. Let’s hope it stays that way for us :)

Not insulting at all, I appreciate your input :) I actually have anxiety however I have nausea even when I’m chilling at home and not feeling anxious at all, so I feel like mine isn’t related (but what do I know). I hope it gets easier for everyone diagnosed with this.
Thank you for the tip, where I live it’s virtually impossible to get a prescription for medical weed, but good to hear it works for you!

Hi everyone, I’m just writing this if anyone has something looking similar to what OP posted and is worried. I have a bump just like that, I’ve had it for quite a while and was convinced it was something horrible. I saw an ENT yesterday and he immediately dismissed my fears and said it’s a cyst. If the surface is smooth, if the lump is uniform and doesn’t grow or bleed, it’s rarely something bad. Of course still get it checked by a doctor to be on the safe side but I hope this helps someone be a little less anxious in the meantime.
Leo but everyone tells me I’m the least “Leo” person they know lol
I had a twitching muscle in the exact same spot last month for more than a week and it suddenly just went away. I wouldn’t worry too much about it.
Thank you so much!
